quest.title: Diamond in the Rough...
quest.description: Smooth-talking Shitou bets you'll enjoy the game he has in store...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x800, Mora x1200, Mora x1600, Mora x2000, Mora x2400, Mora x2800, Mora x3200, Cor Lapis x1, Mora x3600, Noctilucous Jade x1, Mora x4000, Cor Lapis x2, Mora x4400, Noctilucous Jade x2, Mora x4800, Noctilucous Jade x3, Mora x200, Mora x400, Mora x600

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Excuse me, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}! Try your luck on a stone today, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}? This could be your lucky day...

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: #Excellent decision, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, I'm sure you won't regret it! Fortune favors the bold, and by the looks of you, you have nothing to be concerned about!

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Only the choicest raw stones from my store.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: You buy a stone, you cut it open, and providing there's jade inside I pay you handsomely for it. Of course, no jade means no Mora.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: #Easiest way to learn is to buy one for yourself and give it a go, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}!

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: #All you'll find in this store, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, are the choicest raw stones, carefully mined at the Chasm...

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: #Let me put your fears to rest, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}! The Jade Mystery draws on generations' worth of expertise in making jade ornaments. No one has an eye for a jade stone quite like us!

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Although, things aren't quite what they used to be... Not since the Ministry of Civil Affairs shut down the Chasm.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: With no new raw stones coming in, the supply has gradually diminished over time... Now, the stones are rare enough to be more valuable than the jade ornaments themselves, would you believe!

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: So I thought to myself — why not just sell the stones? It saves the processing costs and, I daresay, adds a bit of excitement into one's life.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: What do you say, customer? Fancy a foray into the wonderful world of stone speculating?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: We have an extraordinarily wide selection of raw stones here at The Jade Mystery. One can find oneself a little overwhelmed if one is to peruse the entire collection...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: So I have taken the liberty of sorting them first for your convenience. Might I inquire as to your budget?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: 200 Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #A most prudent decision, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}. Here we are, please select a stone that is to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Choose carefully, mind you. We want to make that 200 Mora worth your investment, don't we?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Once you have made your decision, please inform me and I shall do the honors.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: 400 Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Precisely the amount I recommend to all our new customers, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}: a sum small enough to spare, but big enough to invest.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Over here if you would, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}. Please select the stone you find most agreeable.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Take all the time you need. I will be delighted to do the honors whenever you are ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: 600 Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Most discerning of you, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}! Not every new customer appreciates that one must sow generously in order to reap generously.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Over here if you would, please.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: These are the most exquisite stones in our collection. Please peruse them at your leisure, I'm sure they will stand up to scrutiny.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Once you decide which of them you are most partial to, please inform me and I will be delighted to do the honors.

talks.objective: Choose a type of crude stone

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Each person has their own method of assessing a raw stone's value.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Some rely on pure intuition; they know the stone they want as soon as they lay eyes on it. Others prefer to examine each stone in detail.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Far be it from me to presume which method will work best for you. It is up to you whether to <color=#00E1FFFF>take a closer look</color> or simply <color=#00E1FFFF>go with your gut</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the stone on the yellow cloth.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Certainly, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the stone on the blue cloth.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Right away, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the stone on the red-white cloth.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Of course, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: I'm afraid there is very little jade inside this one indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Never mind. Quite the experience, no? A little Mora invested on scratching the itch is money well spent, I say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You led me to believe there were no bad stones...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Indeed I did! All our stones are responsibly sourced and carefully selected in good faith. To call any of them "bad stones" would therefore be a gross misrepresentation of the facts.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Please don't lose heart! All of us are led astray by a promising-looking but ultimately disappointing stone once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Let me take that for you. If you'd like to keep trying, we can continue straight on. We'll settle the bill at the end.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>I'll calculate how much you're owed</color> at the end. If we do it bit by bit as we go, I'll only confuse myself and you, and that's just no good for anybody.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: What do you say, customer? Another round?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One more try!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Excellent idea! Many a success story starts with those precise words, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Some people say, I'll come here once a day for the rest of my life and I'll be sure to strike lucky eventually. Personally, I prefer your approach — multiple attempts in one day, more of your life left to enjoy the winnings! Over here, if you would please, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That'll do for now...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Quite right, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, quite right! One can't spend all of one's time gambling on stones, it's simply not befitting of a {F#lady}{M#gentleman} of your stature.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One more try!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Ah, erm, well... perhaps now is a good time for {F#Madam}{M#Sir} to call it a day? One must temper one's enthusiasm for such pursuits, and I—I'm afraid I've run out stones...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Between us, I've heard tomorrow is supposed to be a lucky day... You should come back then.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: My goodness... There's jade in here! We have a winner!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #You certainly know hidden treasure when you see it, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Tell me... How exactly did you know? What did you see that other, er, customers may have missed...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to cash in now, please!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh — yes, yes of course... Please, take this!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Until next time, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Aargh! Lord help me... How could I have missed that...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to say that you <color=#00E1FFFF>don't have quite enough Mora</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: To me, every stone in this shop is a valuable treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Even for a slightly cheaper one, I'm afraid the lowest I can do is around... <color=#00E1FFFF>200</color> Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Haven't you inspected them all already?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Not at all {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, I have merely arranged them into very rough groups.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: However closely one might scrutinize a raw stone, and whatever fabulous contraptions one might employ in doing so, the fact is that one only sees the outside.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: I can but broadly speculate as to what treasure a stone might contain, and how much it might be worth...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: To be honest, I genuinely don't know what's inside until the stone is cut open. Nor does anyone else for that matter. Ultimately, when all is said and done, it comes down to sheer luck.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: The worst luck of all is to see a spot of jade visible on the outside of the stone, only to cut it open and find the inside is completely worthless. The best luck of all is to pick a random stone up off the street, break it open, and find it filled with Noctilucous Jade.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #But as I say {F#Madam}{M#Sir}, fortune favors the bold. And the way I look at it, you are certainly bold to have come this far, so I can only imagine that fortune will be looking most favorably on you indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to <color=#00E1FFFF>take a closer look</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: #Be my guest, {F#Madam}{M#Sir}.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Well, look what we have here! It's not the jackpot, sadly, but between you and me — this is a very reasonable result.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: You could almost certainly pawn this for a not-insignificant amount of Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be straight with me, was this a good or a bad one?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Ahaha, well if you insist on putting it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: I'd have to say... this one was neither terribly good, nor terribly bad.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Let me take that for you. If you'd like to keep trying, we can continue straight on. We'll settle the bill at the end.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>I'll calculate how much you're owed</color> at the end. If we do it bit by bit as we go, I'll only confuse myself and you, and that's just no good for anybody.
